# Abigail and David (1 Samuel 25:24)

## Emotional Focus
Showing kindness even when someone is angry.

## Key KJV
“And Abigail came to David… and said, Let thine handmaid speak in thine audience.” (1 Samuel 25:24)

## Gentle Retelling
David was very angry at a mean man, but the man’s wise wife Abigail brought food and kind words. She stopped the anger and David thanked her.

## Coloring Prompt
Abigail riding with baskets of bread and fruit to meet David; calm and brave expression.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Kind words can make a big difference even on angry days.”
